messages:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduling a rolling cordon + reboot for the eu-edge GPU cohort (racks 12-16) this Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. NIC fw has a regression under p99 tx bursts, vendor wants a reboot to apply microcode.
jamie: Plan is staggered cordon per-rack to keep most pools available. Target churn ~4 nodes/minute, 15m per rack for drain+reboot+smoke. Backfill from eu-central spare pool during the window.
jamie: Impact: short tail increases expected on latency-sensitive routes (chat endpoints) for ~3-5 mins per rack. Throughput drop for heavy batching jobs; recommend lowering batch sizes for maintenance window.
sanjay: +1. What's the plan for reserved Dedicated customers in eu-edge? Will we move them or throttle? @olivia FYI for CS/enterprise notices.
jamie: Reserved stays pinned — we'll failover if SLA triggers. For non-reserved hosted traffic we'll route to eu-central and apac-fallback if needed. Using weighted routing: eu-edge 0.6 -> eu-central 0.3 -> apac 0.1 during window.
leo: Ops checklist: pre-warm prefix cache on eu-central, pre-warm KV caches for active sessions, increase short-term autoscale headroom by +20% on eu-central. Also ensure optimizer job (batch) backfills are paused.
maria: For canary: can we do 1 rack first and watch p95 for 30m? If green, continue. If not, rollback and abort remainder.
jamie: Yes — canary rack 12. We'll gate by p95 < 1.5x baseline and error rate delta < 0.1%. Abort conditions listed in the runbook.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: MAINT-7892 by jamie — Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying oncall and paging if rollback triggered.
leo: Quick snippet for cordon/drain (use this in runbook):

```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12-0
kubectl drain gpu-node-12-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
# wait for pods reschedule and prefix cache warm
```

maria: Also add a temporary routing policy to prevent traffic bouncing between regions — sticky to fallback once moved for the duration of window.
olivia: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for enterprise console and email: concise, mention expected <5m latency blips per rack, no data loss, reserved instances unaffected but may experience fallback.
sanjay: Cost note: using eu-central spare pool and apac fallback will add ~0.6x egress and cross-region transfer cost for ~2 hours. Estimate ~ $1.2k extra. Flagged to finance.
jamie: Thanks — ops, oncall, and SRE teams please ack. We'll post runbook link once tests are in CI.
leo: ack
maria: ack
olivia: ack, sending draft
ops-bot: oncall: @sre-nightshift assigned for MAINT-7892
